One person, every creative.

I'm Kishan, based in Hyderabad. I handle all the creatives for my own Instagram account, @kishanify, and I make every piece myself: illustrations, typography posters, collages, comic carousels and the hand-drawn pages in between.

Because concept, design and editing sit with one person, the feed keeps a single voice from post to post.

Day to day I work in digital marketing, running paid campaigns and reading the analytics, so I design with results in mind.
